desc:
🚐 Drive your own Indonesian ANGKOT!
Pick up passengers, earn Rupiah and build the craziest modif in town.

🆕 BIG CITY UPDATE
🏙️ New 5 km city: Sudirman, campus, harbour, industry, stadium, train station, beach & Puncak hills
🗺️ 9 loop routes, new terminals, GPS + minimap
🎓 New tutorial with a Rp 150.000 starter reward
💾 Garage SAVES: keep up to 3 styles for free
🏆 Global leaderboards + Top Spenders podium
📱 Smoother on phones

🧍 Pick up people at the bus stops, drop them off, get paid
🔧 70+ mods: bodykits, rims, liveries, LED, suspension, party interior
✍️ Your own name on the windshield
👵 Grannies tip you... if you drive gently
🎁 Daily rewards, missions, weekly goals, driver levels
👥 Play with friends: +10% fare each

💾 Everything is saved.
